title: Ultrasensitive detection of alogliptin via fluorescence quenching of terbium-doped carbon quantum dots: mechanistic investigation, Box–Behnken optimization and analytical evaluation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19468-19479
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02737C, Paper
Open Access

Ahmed Serag, Farooq M. Almutairi, Muneef M. Aldhafeeri, Rami M. Alzhrani, Maram H. Abduljabbar, Reem M. Alnemari, Yusuf S. Althobaiti, Atiah H. Almalki
A novel fluorescence turn-off sensor using Tb-CQDs was developed for alogliptin determination. Key parameters were optimized using a Box–Behnken design, and the method was validated according to ICH guidelines.
